name: Ananya
experience: My U&I journey started in 2022 as a volunteer, and stepping up as a leader at Adheera has been the best decision ever. I’ve grown so much as a person, and my co-leaders made the whole ride even more amazing. Super grateful to have Harusha, Neeraj, and Subhash around, they’ve been the best. Huge shoutout to Mahima and Meghana for always being there and having my back. Adheera’s first year had the dream team of volunteers, and the kids honestly had the time of their lives.

name: Subhash
experience: U&I at Adheera has nothing short of magical. Nothing gives me more joy than having played a small part in setting up a new centre from scratch to now, being a community powerhouse and a garage of impact. This dream team of 40 including my super co-leaders and amazing volunteers left no stone unturned in our first year bringing Adheera to life. I’m glad to have worked along side such talents who brought such energy and creativity to this centre with such positive intent. Adheera is extremely close to my heart, for being a centre that gave me so much unexpected love and warmth in return for my small efforts!

name: Harusha
experience: Adheera has been my second home. From the leaders to volunteers and to the notorious boys. The year 2024-25 tested my leadership skills on a professional scale and on a personal scale. But not even once did my team let me go, I'll forever be grateful for the family I have made and the LC I got. My LC encapsulates my chaotic but creative side and have always shined. Time and time again they've always shined and did amazing, which is a testament to my leadership. U&I has been an amazing and a unique journey which I will always cherish.

name: Neeraj
experience: My experience at U&I has been truly special, as a volunteer at KRT & Belaku, and later as a leader at Adheera. It’s been an unforgettable journey with my co-leaders and volunteers, one that’s become a core part of my life. U&I is not just a place to teach kids, but a space where we built a beautiful family. There are so many memories I’ll carry with me and cherish until I return someday. I’m going to miss it all so much.

name: Meghana
experience: Adheera, a name that embodies strength and resilience has stood unwavering and fearless throughout the year. What began as an expansion center in Bengaluru West has grown into one of the most rewarding journeys, thanks to the dedication of the leadership team. Their commitment to innovative teaching, a student-centric approach and fostering a strong sense of community for all volunteers has truly set this center apart. It has been a privilege to read the inspiring stories from Adheera, which reflect the intentional efforts of every volunteer in creating meaningful impact. I'm incredibly grateful for the opportunity to work with the exceptional leaders and volunteers of this center.

name: Mahima
experience: U&I has been such a special part of my life since 2022, more than just a journey, it's been a true blessing. With Adheera, that connection grew stronger, and meeting the kids made me realize how much this truly means to me. From setting up the center to bonding with the sweetest volunteers and students, it's been pure magic. Being a chapter leader here has been the most fulfilling experience, personally and professionally. Forever grateful for this journey, for Adheera, end for the incredible love this community holds.

name: Adithya
experience: My U&I journey started in 2022 as a volunteer, and stepping up as a leader at Adheera has been the best decision ever. I've grown so much as a person, and my co-leaders made the whole ride even more amazing. Super grateful to have Harusha, Neeraj, and Subhash around, they've been the best. Huge shoutout to Mahima and Meghana for always being there and having my back. Adheera's first year had the dream team of volunteers, and the kids honestly had the time of their lives.

name: Anushri
experience: Watching Anand grow has made me so proud- he's come such a long way in reading and writing. Though he's quiet, hearing him say he liked my teaching at year-end meant the world to me. He's truly a little superstar, and I'm glad I could play a small part in his journey. Adheera has been nothing short of magical- from struggling with kids to looking forward to Saturdays. Grateful for the joy, the bonds, and this beautiful family I've found at U&I.

name: Pranathi
experience: Being at U&I has really given me life. ADHEERA has always been full of energy, and every kid there is just amazing. Karthik, who was my first student and the best, loves to learn and works so hard. It's great to see how he balances his sports with his studies. Watching him work hard and reach his goals makes me really happy. It was an absolute fun teaching him, also learnt alot from him.

name: Dheemanth
experience: Teaching Bhargav this past year has been a very fulfilling experience. Watching him grow not just academically but also in confidence has been truly inspiring. From curious questions, like who/ what is God, to determined efforts, he's shown what it means to embrace learning with heart and purpose. I genuinely believe he's on a path to becoming successful, and I feel very lucky to have been a part of his journey.

name: Darshan R
experience: Being a part of U&I and Adheera has certainly brought a lot of changes in me from conversational skills to meeting amazing people and knowing that my student is waiting and looking forward to classes next week and ask for new activities is VERY wholesome and I LOVE IT HERE!!!!!

name: Yeshwanth
experience: Sharan started off quiet but slowly opened up, bringing out his mischievous and super energetic side. He's hardworking, values education deeply, and dreams of bringing change to his village. Though he struggles a bit with confidence, his dedication to learning is truly inspiring. From phonics struggles to reading words confidently, his progress has been amazing to watch. U&I has been one of the best experiences- so much joy, clarity, and gratitude came with it.

name: Archana
experience: Gagan started from scratch, but his focus and confidence helped him grow massively in English. His progress is super impressive and speaks volumes about his determination. Adheera felt like just another NGO at first, but it quickly became home. The energy, effort, and love from every leader, volunteer, and kid was truly motivating. It became my happy place, something I looked forward to every single week.

name: Amith
experience: Sharana Basappa has been really smart and he's a quick learner who grasps things right from the get go. He already knew phonics pretty well which eventually made him good at writing spellings and also reading new simple words. His progress is so amazing that by the end of the year I was able to teach him nearly 10 topics and he also remembers most of it which makes it even better to hear. Talking about my experience at Adheera, it has been a very comfortable environment with so many amazing people to talk and reach out to anytime. As I always said, couldn't ask for a better gang!!

name: Shivani
experience: Let's see, being a part of Adheera has been such a joy. I would say it was the best thing I ever signed up for. I joined Adheera thinking 'I guess I can do something efficient during the weekends' but ended up being 'I can't wait for Saturdays, I wonder what I can do this time to make learning fun for the kids'. I think it is quite obvious that I am not much of conversation starter but everyone in Adheera have been so patient and understanding .The volunteers always made me feel welcomed which was pretty overwhelming at the beginning but I that about them now. I learnt something new every weekend not just from the volunteers but also  from the kids which would be my highlight for the week. But not just that, Adheera made me realize what having a purpose means and what passion is, which I may have forgotten through the whole process of being an adult. A huge shoutout to my leader Ananya, she was like warm rays of sunshine who I knew always had my back and I seriously don't know how she was so patient and understanding the whole time.

name: Charu Keerthi
experience: Sainath has shown remarkable progress in English! He's gone from struggling with sentences and vocabulary to speaking much more fluently. His dedication and memory made him a joy to teach. U&I at Adheera provided a fantastic environment to witness his growth. It's been a truly rewarding experience seeing his potential.

name: Infancia
experience: My journey at U&I was just awesome, I loved every moment with my kid Sunil. I'm super proud of him; he always gave his best and kept trying to learn new things. It felt like I'd known him forever- we instantly clicked and built a sweet bond. I even learnt new things myself while teaching him, which made it so special. Teaching Sunil has been the best part of U&I for me, and I'm so grateful!

name: Venkatesh
experience: I am Venky and my U&I experience has been the most positive experience I've ever had. From the start, Paramananda has always been a very enthusiastic kid, he always greeted me with a warm smile and an excitement to learn. Through all the thick and thin, nothing ever failed to drop those smiles. Really thankful to everyone for making it turn out this way.

name: Rakshitha
experience: Teaching in U&I has taught me sooo much and I am grateful for everything this community has given me this year. Teaching Gangadhar was sooo easy, he is a super smart kid and learnt most of the topics super fast. He was always focused and retained everything taught. His dedication and will to learn and do good inspired me to come and help him out every week. Overall this was an unforgettable experience and I'll always cherish it.

name: Disha
experience: Being part of U&I has been one of the best experiences ever, it gave me a community that always had each other's back. This place has taught me so much, and I'll always look back at it with gratitude. My student, Basavraj, was really well-behaved, read and wrote well, and always gave his best. The only area he struggled with was understanding passages, which we started working on from September. Though the time was short, we tried our best, and he's definitely on the path to improving!

name: Neelima
experience: My experience at U&I was truly amazing! I absolutely loved teaching Bharath- he's such a bright and curious soul. Watching him learn and grow brought me so much joy, and I'm incredibly proud of him. I'm really looking forward to more moments like these, more little wins, and more hearts to teach and learn from!

name: Darshan
experience: I had a really good experience teaching at U&I. Teaching Sanjay and Dhanush was always fun. I truly enjoyed listening to their answers, hobbies, interests and goals. Both of them understand the importance of studying and give it their all. I'm really thankful to everyone around me for helping me out whenever needed.

name: Vijetha
experience: It's been such a journey of learning and growing with Eeresh. His goals, his excitement to learn, and that happy little smile whenever he saw me really pushed me to show up every weekend. Saturdays just hit different because of the kids. It's honestly been such an amazing experience to be part of. Can't wait to make even more memories with the lil ones and this beautiful community!

name: Mani
experience: I have been teaching Shreyas and have to say that it was quite a joy to go through this academic year. I am in awe of his journey through the year and how he has found his energy and commitment towards learning. He is poised for great days ahead with clarity on what he wants.

name: Supriya
experience: I had an amazing experience at U&I getting an opportunity to help my kid achieve his true potential has been a fulfilling experience. I had begun my classes with my kid who was very shy and quiet but later he slowly opened up and his curiosity to learning new things has been really motivating for me.

name: Shalini
experience: Bhagwan is a sweet and quiet kid who takes time but always gives his best while learning. He listens intently, and with patience and encouragement, he slowly begins to understand. Those little moments when things click for him have been truly special to witness. U&I has given me the chance to be part of something so meaningful and full of warmth. The journey has been rewarding, filled with amazing kids and friendships I truly cherish.

name: Keertana
experience: My experience at Adheera and U&I has been nothing short of magical! From the moment I met Santhosh and Mohith, we instantly clicked, they were friendly, polite, and eager to learn. They always had a healthy sense of competition between them and picked up so many new things along the way. I genuinely looked forward to classes every weekend because they were just so much fun! I'm truly glad and grateful to have been a part of their lives and this beautiful community.

name: Yadu
experience: Teaching Jashwanth this past year has honestly been such a nice experience. He was super quiet in the beginning, barely spoke a word. But slowly he started opening up and now there's a whole vibe when we talk. It's been great seeing him grow not just with studies but also with how he's become more confident and chill. I've learned a lot from our sessions too. Really grateful to U&I for letting me be part of something like this.

name: Raksha
experience: My experience at Adheera was amazing! Chetan was a bit shy at first and wasn't too enthusiastic, but as time passed, he opened up and shared his interests! He'd eagerly ask for storybooks and wanted to learn to read. It was heartwarming to see him grow! I personally enjoyed every moment and it taught me so much about patience and joy of learning. I'm grateful for the experience and the bond we formed!!

name: Nihaal
experience: My experience was unforgettable.. Siddu was full of energy and would often run around, making me chase him to keep up, but beneath the playful exterior, he had a sense of responsibility and knew the importance of learning. He has made a good progress and I've loved watching him grow. I'm grateful for the experience!

name: Jayanth
experience: My journey at U&I has been eye-opening, especially seeing the wage-education gap during my first class. Teaching Dhruva was tough, he's sharp and intuitive, yet often detached. Getting him to focus and retain was a challenge, but all credit for his growth goes to him. I've realized that my role here is just to be a facilitator, not the hero. U&I made me more aware of the gaps in education and the change we need to bring.

name: Bharat
experience: Samarth has truly been the greatest kid I've ever had the joy of teaching. From the start, his energy, curiosity, and excitement to learn stood out. I remember looking at his pre-assessment form and feeling unsure about how to connect with him---but I chose to believe he was a superkid, and he proved me right. Watching him grow from recognizing letters to confidently reading words has been nothing short of incredible. His progress made every moment at Adheera worthwhile. If I had the chance, I'd do it all over again without hesitation. Teaching Samarth has been an unforgettable, heartwarming, inspiring, joyful, magical, wholesome, fulfilling, and absolutely delightful experience.

name: Satwik
experience: On the first day I met Kiran, Neeraj told me we were paired because we both had charming smiles, I'm not sure about mine, but his definitely is! What truly amazed me was his progress; from learning alphabets and their sounds to confidently reading and spelling English words. Despite limited classes, his growth was incredible and so heartwarming to see. I'm beyond proud to have been his teacher, especially with how well he did in the IA despite his emotional struggles. This experience has been so meaningful, and I'm genuinely grateful for it.

name: Anish
experience: Venugopal is a kid I thought I was teaching, but turns out, I've learnt so much from him too. His curiosity and energy pushed me to think differently and stay open-minded. Our bond turned into a two-way street of learning and growth that I truly value. Being part of this vibrant community has only amplified that feeling. It doesn't just feel like a group, it feels like family.

name: Siri
experience: My experience at U&I came with so many takeaways, it made me realize how much I love being around people. Like I always say, U&I truly feels like home. Looking back at the whole journey now feels so surreal. Manoj was amazing, I watched him grow from a shy kid to someone so much more expressive. I enjoyed every class with him, and I already miss teaching him.

name: Anagha
experience: My experience at U&I was insightful and truly amazing! I have enjoyed seeing Biresh learn and change. I see myself in him- the hesitation, the curiosity and the willingness to learn. He's come so far from the pre-assessments and has learnt so much. Learning with him has truly been amazing!

name: Khushi
experience: Teaching Sandeep this year has been such a wholesome experience- he always gave his best, even when unsure. His energy, especially when rewards were involved, made classes so fun and engaging. What stood out most was his "never give up" attitude, he'd keep trying till he got it right. Seeing his confidence grow week by week has been super special. My U&I journey at Adheera has been so fulfilling, and I'm just really grateful to be part of it!

name: Akhila
experience: My time at U&I was nothing short of bliss. Aditya was super quiet at first, but slowly opened up and got really into learning. Even after being on a two-month break due to illness, he did great in his mid-year assessment. He's super creative, loves coloring, and now reads words and sentences smoothly. His excitement to learn more has been so amazing to watch!

name: Swaroop
experience: U&I was a blessing during a rough phase, it gave me the break I needed and I loved every bit of it. I vibed so well with Srishila from day one, even though teaching him was a challenge. Watching him go from zero English to confidently using words was such a win! Huge thanks to the community and Yadu for bringing me into this journey, will cherish it always!

name: Sandeep
experience: U&I has been a part of my Saturdays for over a year now, and the overall experience has been truly fulfilling! I'm grateful to the leaders and fellow volunteers for making this journey so enjoyable and meaningful. My student, Karthik, showed good progress throughout the year. But I can't help feeling that we could've achieved even more together, I guess that's a common feeling among teachers; we always want to push our kids to reach their fullest potential.

name: Daniel
experience: Uday had a huge interest in space and drawing, and along with that, he had an amazing eagerness to learn more. He had this crazy energy that never seemed to run out! Teaching him was really peaceful, he always listened so well and made the whole experience so smooth. Honestly, I can't even put into words how good this journey was. I'm just really happy and proud that I got to teach Uday.
